principles: Each inhabited star system has its own government or recognized governing authority.
System governments control vessel registration, customs, port access, local resource rights, criminal law and commercial enforcement inside their jurisdiction.
Concord standards enable interoperability but do not create a suprasystem government.
A vessel may operate without registration where local law or enforcement allows it, but doing so sharply limits access to reputable commerce.

governments.name: Sol System Authority
governments.notes: Large mature bureaucracy with strong electronic records and extensive reciprocal verification.

governments.name: Keshar Civic Directorate
governments.notes: Places unusual emphasis on structural certification and maintenance accountability.

governments.name: Ilos System Assembly
governments.notes: Detailed mass, propulsion and modification records are central to registration.

governments.name: Veyara Waters and Orbital Council
governments.notes: Environmental compliance and closed-cycle systems receive particular scrutiny.

governments.name: Orun Junction Council
governments.notes: Registration records emphasize service access and infrastructure compatibility.

governments.name: Concord Administration
governments.notes: Efficient, standards-heavy and widely trusted by insurers and cargo owners.

governments.name: Roosevelt System Government
governments.notes: Popular with independents because yard inspections and registration services are easy to combine.

governments.name: Hesperus Commonwealth
governments.notes: Routine commercial registry with strong agricultural biosecurity requirements.

governments.name: Iron Gate Industrial Authority
governments.notes: Heavy vessels and orbital-only construction receive specialized registry classes.

governments.name: Carver Habitat Authority
governments.notes: Registry focuses heavily on declared mass, transponders and collision liability.

governments.name: Bradbury Civil Administration
governments.notes: Research and hazardous scientific equipment can add endorsements to ordinary vessel registration.

governments.name: Pelagos Joint Authority
governments.notes: Recognizes specialized amphibious and marine-capable vessel certifications.

governments.name: Tidemark Platform Council
governments.notes: Weatherworthiness and emergency reserve requirements are important for surface-operating ships.

governments.name: Foundry Deepworks Authority
governments.notes: Industrial and hazardous-cargo endorsements are common.

governments.name: Meridian Station Authority
governments.notes: Registration is enforced at major commercial berths, while some peripheral docks tolerate unregistered traffic.

governments.name: Talos Provisional Authority
governments.notes: Registry exists and is increasingly enforced, but growth has outpaced inspectors and records.

governments.name: Waystation Council
governments.notes: Registered ships receive easier commercial access; unregistered vessels are common enough not to cause immediate alarm.

governments.name: Lastlight Civil Office
governments.notes: Ordinary registration enforcement is modest, but survey, biological and expedition documentation is taken seriously.
